| MINI PROJECT CANVAS | Title: Seasonal and Weather based HSL City Bike AllocationWhere should more bikes be allocated each month or quarter? | Group members: Chenyu Wu, Jizhou Wang, Jussi HonkioWorkshop \#: 3 |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |

&nbsp;

| MOTIVATION  ![][image1] Target Audience: city-bike operators and HSL transport planners. Identify which bike stations around Helsinki should receive greater allocation or redistribution attention monthly/quarterly and how weather and weather forecast data affect the fleet usage on different locations and city-bike trips. Issue Addressed: improve bike availability and use the fleet more efficiently. | DATA COLLECTION  ![][image2] HSL Open Data: hsl.fi/en/hsl/open-dataJourneys made by city bikes. Weather data, local weather forecast data Finnish Meteorotical Institute (FMI) Monthly journey CSVs: origin and destination stations, times, distance and duration. Use several complete cycling seasons. Add station coordinates for maps.&nbsp; | PREPROCESSING  ![][image3] Check duplicates, invalid trips, missing timestamps and station IDs. Align station identifiers across years; account for openings and closures. Aggregate departures and returns by station and month. Retain weekday and time-of-day patterns. Features: month, quarter, operating days, historical trip counts and departure-return differences. *Treat unavailable months and closed seasons separately from zero usage.* | EXPLORATORY DATAANALYSIS (EDA)  ![][image4] Compare station usage across months and years. Locate seasonal hotspots and stations with high departures relative to returns. Explore morning and evening patterns that monthly totals may hide. Identify the effect of weather and forecasted weather on city-bike usage and city-bike trips. | VISUALIZATIONS  ![][image5] Station demand map and station-by-month heatmap. Departure and return comparisons; actual versus forecast usage. Interactive filters: month or quarter, station and area. Show ranked priority stations with reasons and forecast uncertainty. |
| :---: | ----- | :---: | :---: | ----- |
| **LEARNING TASK**  ![][image6] Focus on problem definition Supervised regression: predict next-month, week, day, hour completed departures and returns for each station. Aggregate forecasts into quarterly summaries and identify allocation priorities. | **LEARNING APPROACH**  ![][image7] Compare a previous-year same-month baseline, regularized regression and a tree-based model. Train on earlier seasons and weather data and test on later complete months. Evaluate MAE and station-ranking quality, including low-use stations. |  | **COMMUNICATION OFRESULTS**  ![][image8] A planning website and short findings report. Select a time interval, inspect the station map and compare seasonal and activity and the weather effect. Export an allocation-review list with supporting evidence.&nbsp; | **DATA PRIVACY AND ETHICALCONSIDERATIONS**  ![][image9] Publish station-level summaries and avoid identifying individual riders.. Disclose missing data and model uncertainty. Attribute City Bike Finland and HSL; follow CC BY 4.0 terms. |
|  | **ADDED VALUE**  ![][image10] A seasonal bike-allocation dashboard that helps planners identify where additional bikes or redistribution attention may be useful. Expected outcome: monthly station forecasts, quarterly summaries and a priority list. |  |  | **LEGEND** **WEEK 3: Collection / preprocessing** **WEEK 4: EDA / visualizations** **WEEKS 5-6: Models / evaluation** **WEEK 7: Fairness / data privacy** |
